proposalManifest.scope: Dispatch setup and focused-command prevalidation only
proposalManifest.exactOutcome: Before publishing a Luna route, Integration must validate every focused command against the exact repository-root and exact claim-owned output path; reject the dispatch when command arguments or output contracts are invalid.
basis: Four Integration-authored route returns were exposed in the pilot metrics.
The exposed returns include an omitted repository-root/output command contract and a focused output path outside the repository evidence contract.
No Luna worker returns were exposed in the pilot metrics.
proposalManifest.rollback: Disable the prevalidation check and restore the prior dispatch publication path; no product or shared-authority bytes are changed by this receipt.
proposalManifest.acceptance: A later pilot boundary exposes zero Integration-authored route returns attributable to invalid focused-command or output-path contracts, while preserving the existing claim, candidate identity, focused/full gate split, and independent QA.

validationEfficiency.workerPolicy: focused owner and directly affected gates only
validationEfficiency.aggregatePolicy: one full Swift suite and staged build per exact aggregate identity

outcomes.acceptedOutcomesPerFrontierTurnBasis: One valid North visual disposition across five recorded North frontier worker turns; Integration captain turns are not exposed and are excluded.
